subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the four exact-pin guards pass on the final head, should maintainers accept these grouped third-party executable revisions across token, scanning, publishing, repository-automation, and Codex workflows?
rationale: Repository consistency is mechanically repairable, but accepting replacement executable code that handles sensitive credentials and publishing requires explicit owner trust judgment.

options.title: Repair and approve group
options.body: Synchronize all guards, require green exact-head checks, and approve after direct upstream source review by workflow and security owners.

options.title: Split privileged families
options.body: Review token, scanning, publishing, repository-automation, and Codex action updates in narrower pull requests.

options.title: Hold current pins
options.body: Defer the group until owners have sufficient upstream and operational confidence.

recommendation.title: Repair and approve group
recommendation.body: Synchronize all guards, require green exact-head checks, and approve after direct upstream source review by workflow and security owners.
